name: Aleph
summary: The first sulphur-containing phenethylamine to have been evaluated for CNS activity for stimulant or psychedelic purposes.

pharmacology.text: Aleph is known to be a superagonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (EC50 = 10–66 nM; Emax = 114–191%). It has weak MAO-A inhibitory activity with an IC50 of 5.2 μM. For comparison, amphetamine has an IC50 of 11 μM and 4-methylthioamphetamine (4-MTA) has a value of 0.2 μM.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

summaryZh: 阿列夫-1是一種有機化合物，化學式為C12H19NO2S。它是一種苯丙胺類化合物，為致幻劑。它最初由亞歷山大·舒爾金合成，並以希伯來字母的第一個字母命名。它的鹽酸鹽是已知的。
